# Reflecto Premium - Automotive & Commercial Protection

> Reflecto Premium (https://reflecto.com.sa) is a premier specialized automotive paint protection, ceramic coating, window tinting, and commercial protection center in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

## Summary
Reflecto Premium provides state-of-the-art paint protection film (PPF), multi-layer nano-ceramic & graphene coating, high-rejection thermal insulation window tinting, paint correction, smart dashcam installation, and commercial architectural tinting using top-tier US & Canadian materials with up to 10-year official warranties.

---

## Key Services

- [Paint Protection Film (PPF)](https://reflecto.com.sa/services/ppf): Self-healing clear and matte paint protection films protecting vehicles from rock chips, scratches, and harsh environmental elements.
- [Thermal Insulation Window Tint](https://reflecto.com.sa/services/tint): High heat-rejection nano-ceramic window tinting providing up to 99% UV blockage and 95% infrared heat rejection.
- [Nano Ceramic & Graphene Coating](https://reflecto.com.sa/services/nano-ceramic): Hydrophobic multi-layer ceramic and graphene body coatings delivering deep gloss, scratch resistance, and self-cleaning properties.
- [Paint Correction & Polish](https://reflecto.com.sa/services/paint-correction): Professional multi-stage machine polishing removing swirl marks, scratches, oxidation, and restoring paint depth.
- [Smart Dash Cam Installation](https://reflecto.com.sa/services/dash-cam): 4K front and rear smart dash camera installation with parking surveillance, motion detection, and cloud connectivity.
- [Commercial & Architectural Tinting](https://reflecto.com.sa/services/commercial-tinting): Building and storefront heat-rejection glass tinting reducing energy bills and UV exposure.
- [All Services Index](https://reflecto.com.sa/services): Complete index of automotive protection and detailing solutions.

## Public Navigation & Pages

- [Homepage](https://reflecto.com.sa/): Overview of services, promotional hero video, standards, customer reviews, and floating AI assistant.
- [Pricing & Packages](https://reflecto.com.sa/pricing): Transparent pricing catalog, package breakdowns, warranty durations, and direct booking.
- [Branch Locations](https://reflecto.com.sa/branches): Direct Google Maps links, operating hours, phone numbers, and address details for Jeddah & Riyadh branches.
- [Book Appointment](https://reflecto.com.sa/book-service): Online booking system for scheduling installation, inspections, and maintenance appointments.
- [Contact Us](https://reflecto.com.sa/contact): Support form, WhatsApp direct chat (+966558722444), and customer care hotline.
- [Customer Login](https://reflecto.com.sa/login): Client authentication for accessing vehicle job cards, warranty cards, and order tracking.
- [Register Account](https://reflecto.com.sa/register): New customer registration via mobile number and SMS OTP verification.

---

## Customer Portal & Features

- [Client Dashboard](https://reflecto.com.sa/clientDashboard): Self-service portal for tracking active car jobs, inspecting digital vehicle condition reports (5-View interactive car diagrams), downloading digital warranty certificates, viewing invoices, and paying remaining balances.

---

## Administrative & Operations System (Internal)

- [Admin Overview](https://reflecto.com.sa/admin): Comprehensive analytics overview tracking revenue, daily work orders, active vehicle jobs, branch performance, and technician schedules.
- [Work Orders Management](https://reflecto.com.sa/admin/orders): Digital job creation with interactive 5-view car inspection diagram, body damage marking, material assignment, technician dispatch, and status updates.
- [Client & Corporate Management](https://reflecto.com.sa/admin/clients): CRM database managing individual clients, corporate fleet accounts, custom pricing lists, and quotation previews.
- [Branch & Appointment Scheduler](https://reflecto.com.sa/admin/scheduling): Interactive branch calendar managing daily capacity, bay assignments, and appointment notifications.
- [Roles & Permissions](https://reflecto.com.sa/admin/permissions): Granular access control for admins, branch managers, cashiers, and technicians.

---

## Quality Standards & Warranties

- **ISO Certified Standards**: Strict ISO-certified application processes and dust-free climate-controlled installation bays.
- **US & Canadian Materials**: Highest grade TPU paint protection films and ceramic formulas imported directly from certified manufacturers.
- **Official Electronic Warranties**: Up to 10 years warranty registered electronically in the customer portal covering yellowing, peeling, cracking, and adhesive failure.
- **Free Periodic Maintenance**: Scheduled inspection and maintenance washes included with protection packages.

---

## Technical Architecture

- **Frontend**: React 18, Vite, React Router 6, TanStack React Query v5, TailwindCSS, i18next (Arabic RTL & English LTR).
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express.js, MySQL (`reflecto_db`), JWT Authentication, Taqnyat SMS OTP Integration.
- **PWA & Performance**: Optimized web font loading, lazy-loaded routes, dynamic asset caching, and responsive cross-platform layout.
